warnings.message: ask write deploy/** dropped on codex: Codex has no ask for writes or tools

accepted.message: write **/.git/hooks/**: a filesystem "read" downgrade covers sandboxed commands, not the apply_patch tool
accepted.reason: the .git/hooks write deny downgrades sandboxed commands only; the product's walls (L2 hook deny) refuse apply_patch there

accepted.message: fail_if_unavailable has no documented Codex key
accepted.reason: the launcher refuses to start Codex where its sandbox is unavailable

accepted.message: max_turns, max_usd have no documented codex exec flag (a runner timeout enforces max_minutes only)
accepted.reason: the runner stops a Codex run at the turn and spend caps from its own run records, and at max_minutes by timeout
